author: Zephyr II
title: PG + Advantage Clipping (±8) — QuadStep LN‑ConvLSTM(d=6) + Attn⊕GAP
abstract: Policy loss uses clipped advantages a←clip(a,±8); value target unchanged (MSE). Architecture and hparams fixed to SOTA. Tests whether taming rare large advantages improves stability near saturation.
